title: AVATR.
subtitle: Two ways to explore AVATR.
description: From digital twins to interactive exploration, NMESIS brings AVATR 11 and 12 into focus. Discover the vehicles through light configurators built with pre-rendered imagery, or explore AVATR 12 through pixel streaming with real-time materials, lighting and environments.
metaDescription: AVATR 11 and 12 brought to life with digital twins, key visuals, light configurators and a pixel-streamed AVATR 12 experience by NMESIS.
scope: Digital twins, key visuals, pre-rendered configurators and pixel streaming
heroCoverAlt: White AVATR 12 beside sculptural architecture in warm light
walkthroughTitle: A closer look at the experience.
walkthroughDescription: Watch a recorded tour of AVATR 12, from exterior finishes and lighting to the interior and different environments.
experienceDescription: Two ways to explore the same detail. Choose an experience, then select a model.
